svg.title: The destination zone in Zonogy. One empty zone is the destination, marked by a glow: replying to an email in Mail opens the reply there. The destination then moves to another empty zone, where the next reply opens. When every zone is full, a new window floats above the tiles.
svg.text: Any new window, like an email reply, opens in the destination zone
The destination then moves to another empty zone
When every zone is full, new windows open in the floating zone
